rdfs:label: dateTimeClass
Attributes: allowedCharacter=digits, allowedCharacter=T, allowedCharacter=hyphen, allowedCharacter=colon, allowedCharacter=period, allowedCharacter=Z, allowedCharacter=plus
dc:description: Date-times conform to the BIDS Datetime format, RFC 3339 with an optional offset: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss (year, month, day, hour (24h), minute, second), an optional fraction of one to six digits, and an optional Z for UTC or a +hh:mm or -hh:mm offset.

rdfs:label: nameClass
dc:description: Value class designating values that have the characteristics of node names. The allowed characters are alphanumeric, hyphen, and underscore.

rdfs:label: numericClass
Attributes: allowedCharacter=digits, allowedCharacter=E, allowedCharacter=e, allowedCharacter=plus, allowedCharacter=hyphen, allowedCharacter=period
dc:description: Value must be a valid numerical value.

rdfs:label: textClass
dc:description: Values that have the characteristics of text. The allowed characters are the printable characters (32 <= ASCII < 127) and non-ASCII characters, excluding comma, square brackets, curly braces, parentheses, number sign, and tilde, which are structural in HED strings.
